questions.q: Before a meeting, Salimata tells a joke so everyone feels relaxed. She helps ___ .
questions.e: Break the ice veut dire détendre l’atmosphère au début d’une rencontre.

questions.q: After reviewing the plan together, the two teams are ___ .
questions.e: On the same page signifie être d’accord ou avoir la même compréhension.

questions.q: He wanted to accept the offer, but at the last moment he ___ .
questions.e: Get cold feet veut dire perdre son assurance et hésiter.

questions.q: “The answer is exactly right,” said the teacher. “You ___.”
o: hit the nail on the head
questions.e: Hit the nail on the head veut dire viser juste.

questions.q: I won't come to football today; I'm feeling ___ .
questions.e: Under the weather veut dire ne pas se sentir bien.

questions.q: I have shared my proposal. Now ___; you can decide.
o: the ball is in your court
questions.e: The ball is in your court signifie que c’est à toi d’agir ou de décider.

questions.q: We visit that small island only ___, perhaps once every few years.
o: at the drop of a hat
questions.e: Once in a blue moon signifie très rarement.

questions.q: The phone costs far too much; it would ___ .
o: cost an arm and a leg
questions.e: Cost an arm and a leg signifie coûter très cher.

questions.q: Please ___ the children while I speak to the teacher.
questions.e: Keep an eye on veut dire surveiller.

questions.q: The builders used weak materials to save money; they ___ .
questions.e: Cut corners signifie faire quelque chose trop vite ou à moindre coût, souvent au détriment de la qualité.

questions.q: She answered a different question and ___ .
questions.e: Miss the point signifie ne pas comprendre l’idée principale.

questions.q: I can't meet tonight, but can I ___ and meet you next week?
questions.e: Take a rain check veut dire reporter une invitation à une autre fois.

questions.q: We have finished the report for today; let's ___ .
questions.e: Call it a day signifie arrêter le travail pour aujourd’hui.

questions.q: At first the game was difficult, but I soon ___ .
questions.e: Get the hang of something veut dire apprendre à le faire.

questions.q: Each team member must ___ and do a fair share of the work.
questions.e: Pull your weight signifie faire sa part du travail.

questions.q: The first plan failed, so the team was ___ .
questions.e: Back to square one signifie devoir recommencer depuis le début.

questions.q: As a rule of thumb, save a little money each month. Here, rule of thumb means ___.
questions.e: A rule of thumb est une règle pratique générale.

questions.q: The rumour may be false, so take it ___ .
questions.e: Take something with a grain of salt veut dire ne pas le croire sans réserve.

questions.q: I am ___ about whether to study law or medicine.
questions.e: In two minds signifie hésiter entre deux choix.

questions.q: She had to ___ to finish the project before morning.
questions.e: Burn the midnight oil signifie travailler tard dans la nuit.

questions.q: The invitation arrived ___, just as we were leaving.
questions.e: Out of the blue veut dire de façon inattendue.

questions.q: To ___, we need more time and a smaller budget.
questions.e: Make a long story short sert à résumer brièvement.

questions.q: The advice is free, with ___; you do not have to buy anything.
questions.e: No strings attached signifie sans condition cachée.

questions.q: He hinted that the plan was cancelled, but I didn't ___ .
questions.e: Get the message veut dire comprendre l’idée ou le sous-entendu.
